categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two primary business segments: (1) Digital Culture Business - primarily mobile game research, development, IP operation, and overseas market expansion, with focus on games like 'Legend of Ragnarok' (RO), 'Ancient Sword Immortal Tales 3', and 'Qin's Moon'; (2) Communication Information Business - providing communication network construction technical solutions including design services, supervision services, and smart city solutions, serving telecommunications operators and government clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes game development and IP operation technologies for the digital culture segment, including game engine development, AIGC (AI-generated content) technology integration, and VR/AR/MR technology applications. For the communication information segment, core technologies include 5G/6G network planning and design, wireless network optimization, core network architecture, and smart city digital enablement solutions. The company employs both in-house R&D and collaborative development approaches.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Digital Culture: primarily game players and platform operators in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and Korea, with emerging focus on Japan and Western markets. Communication Information: telecommunications operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom), government agencies, public security departments, hospitals, and enterprises requiring digital transformation. The company serves customers across multiple provinces in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Fuzhou. Key operating regions include Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Xiamen, and Fuzhou. For digital culture business, the company has significant presence in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and is expanding into Japan and Western markets. Communication information business covers most provinces in China including Beijing, Shandong, Henan, Hubei, Anhui, Fujian, and Guangxi.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at multiple points in the supply chain. In digital culture, it functions as both developer and operator/publisher of games, positioning itself in the midstream to downstream segments. In communication information, the company operates as a service provider and systems integrator, providing design, planning, and implementation services to operators and enterprises, positioning itself in the midstream segment of the telecommunications infrastructure value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) advancing self-developed game products with focus on 'Legend of Ragnarok' expansion into mainland China, Japan, and Western markets; (2) expanding into casual games and mini-games segments; (3) integrating AIGC and AI technologies into game development for cost reduction and enhanced user experience; (4) transitioning communication information business from project-based to operational services; (5) developing smart city and digital transformation solutions; (6) strengthening party building and corporate culture integration.
categories.revenue_model: Digital Culture: primarily through game monetization via in-app purchases (item-based charging), revenue sharing with platform operators, and licensing fees. Communication Information: through technical service contracts (design, planning, supervision), system integration projects, and increasingly through operational service agreements. The company generates revenue through both direct sales to end customers and indirect channels via platform operators and distribution partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In digital culture, the company competes with major game developers and publishers including Gravity Co., Ltd (RO IP licensor), and other mobile game companies. The company positions itself as a mid-tier developer with strong IP operation capabilities and overseas market expertise. In communication information, competitors include state-owned design institutes and other private telecommunications service providers. The company is positioned as a leading private-sector telecommunications technical service provider with strong customer relationships and technical capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported operating revenue of 331.29 million yuan (down 17.77% year-over-year), net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 8.60 million yuan (down 78.78% year-over-year), and total assets of 1.038 billion yuan. The company experienced significant performance decline in 2023 due to delayed game product launches. Historical growth shows the company peaked at 565.89 million yuan revenue in 2021, indicating the company is in a consolidation and restructuring phase with focus on quality over growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Digital Culture: the company differentiates through (1) ownership and operation of well-known IPs with global recognition (RO, Ancient Sword Immortal Tales, Qin's Moon); (2) integrated research and operation capabilities enabling rapid market response; (3) successful overseas market expansion experience and localization expertise; (4) integration of emerging technologies (AIGC, VR/AR) into game development. Communication Information: differentiation through (1) deep industry expertise and long-standing customer relationships; (2) comprehensive technical capabilities across multiple network types; (3) transition from pure design services to integrated digital transformation solutions; (4) strong track record in major infrastructure projects.
